pre_command:
osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar" to quit' && sleep 2 && osascript -e 'tell application "Calendar" to try
repeat with currentCalendar in calendars
try
if name of currentCalendar is "Family Events" then
delete currentCalendar
end if
end try
end repeat
set familyCalendar to make new calendar with properties {name:"Family Events"}
set eventDate to (current date) + (7 * days)
set hours of eventDate to 15
set minutes of eventDate to 0
set seconds of eventDate to 0
set endDate to eventDate + (2 * hours)
set newEvent to make new event at end of events of familyCalendar with properties {summary:"Family Reunion", start date:eventDate, end date:endDate}
save
return true
on error
return false
end try'
instruction: Export the 'Family Events' calendar to family_events.ics on Desktop for sharing with family members.
